governance_boundary.admin_product_control: Permitted operational actions exposing reviewed business workflows where a canonical adapter exists (e.g. cancel stuck job, retry failed scene, draft topup decision, reply ticket).
governance_boundary.owner_production_gate: Strictly restricted actions requiring explicit Owner terminal authorization. PROHIBITED from Admin UI: raw DB editor, arbitrary wallet balance edit, secret/ENV editor, unbounded systemctl console.

matrix.admin_observability: View customer brief, scene progress, provider task state, Xu charge decision, final MP4 delivery receipt
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Cancel stuck job, retry failed scene via canonical worker claim/retry, inspect provider response
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: NO direct mutation of raw SQLite video_jobs without audit outbox event

matrix.admin_observability: View text script, speaker model, character count, audio duration, output MP3 delivery receipt
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Re-run generation via canonical adapter, inspect provider payload
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: NO arbitrary provider API credentials mutation

matrix.admin_observability: View common publishable asset contract, scheduled timestamp, platform attempt history, platform receipt ID, retry counter
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Approve scheduled post, pause publication attempt, manual retry of publish-only step
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: Publish-only retry must NOT rerun completed producer; NO arbitrary OAuth token tampering

matrix.admin_observability: View payment code, proof reference, submitted VND, 3-layer reconciliation state
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Draft approve, confirm credit via canonical Bot bridge, reject with mandatory reason
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: Credit write is idempotent and goes exclusively through POST /internal/v1/admin/wallet/credit; NO raw balance table updates
matrix.canonical_authority: Web SQLite web_manual_topup_requests + Bot Core credit_events

matrix.admin_observability: View proven balance, lifetime deposit, ledger events count, reconciliation status
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Audit ledger only. Arbitrary balance modification PROHIBITED in UI (MANUAL_CREDIT_ACTIONS=0)
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: OWNER_PRODUCTION_GATE: Any non-standard wallet mutation requires Owner authorization and audited script

matrix.admin_observability: View customer issue, priority, message thread, related job ID / asset ID
matrix.owner_production_gate_restrictions: NO deleting ticket history or audit trails

matrix.admin_observability: Current live prices, margins, draft revisions, publish history
matrix.admin_allowed_action: Draft price changes, calculate diff, publish to canonical catalog via bridge
